hook: Skipping blood pressure pills the morning of surgery cut low blood pressure in older patients
hook_turn: cut low blood pressure in older patients
summary: In 2036 older Chinese patients on ACE inhibitors or ARBs, half took a placebo instead of their pill on surgery morning. Low blood pressure during surgery was less common without the drug, and vasopressor use dropped, with no difference in 30-day complications or deaths. The trial ran at five hospitals in one country and only followed patients for 30 days.
title: Effect of discontinuing antihypertensives on perioperative hypotension in older patients before non-cardiac surgery: multicentre, randomised, double blind, controlled trial.
